WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        packaging_id AS root_id,
        contains_id AS current_id,
        qty AS qty_multiplier,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        pt.qty_multiplier * pr.qty,
        pt.depth + 1
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_leaf_quantity) AS average_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(qty_multiplier) AS total_leaf_quantity
    FROM packaging_tree
    WHERE current_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY root_id
);
